standard-dialogue.npc: Look [miss/pal] I got the goods if you have the cash.
We talkin' the same language yet?

options.text: Yes, I am here for the stuff.

steps.npc: The sort of stuff you use in brewing.
The sort of stuff the Cooking Guild banned last year.
The sort of stuff that (if added to a vat of brewing ingredients just before the hops) has a higher chance of producin' a mature batch of whatever ale you wanted to make.
That sort of stuff.

steps.player: What was that bit about adding it to something?

steps.npc: I said, it's the sort of Stuff you add to a brewing vat after you have put the water and barley malt in.
THEN you add the sort of stuff I'm talking about, followed by the hops and the yeast.
Then, when whatever you are making brews it will have a higher chance of being a mature batch of ale.
That clear enough for you or am I going to have to start drawin' pictures on the wall of the hut?

options.text: Yes, I am here for the stuff.

steps.npc: Then sling yer 'ook!

options.text: I hear you are the man to talk to about maps.

steps.player: I hear you are the man to talk to about maps.

steps.npc: I might be, you got something for me?
Like...5000 Pieces of Eight?

steps.text: If the player has 5,000 pieces of eight:

steps.player: I might have 5000 Pieces of Eight with your name on them if you have a map for me.

steps.npc: Look, I might have a little something for you for that amount of cash, but I'll have to check.
You sure you want in on this?
Ok, there you go, now try and keep this to yourself, ok?
Then sling yer 'ook!

steps.text: If the player does not have 5,000 pieces of eight:

steps.npc: Look, you want something or not?
Then sling yer 'ook!

options.text: I have no idea what you mean.

steps.player: I have no idea what you are talking about.

steps.npc: Then sling yer 'ook!

standard-dialogue-right-click-trade-opti.npc: Are you here for the stuff?

options.text: Yes, I am here for the stuff.
I hear you are the man to talk to about maps.

when-using-the-right-click-join-team-opt.text: If the player has something equipped in the helmet slot:

steps.npc: Sorry, no hats allowed. Shove it in the deposit box if you want to play.
Cos it's one of the rules, you got a problem with rules?

steps.player: Yes, I am sort of a pirate after all.

steps.npc: Good answer!
But still, no hats. They give you a hat to show what team you are on, and if you got a hat on, it might get nicked, see?

when-using-the-right-click-join-team-opt.text: If the player has items in their inventory:

steps.npc: Might want to dump that stuff yer holdin'.
Well, if you are carrying anything in there, then it might get damaged. Burned up, that kind of thing.
You might want to put it in the bank, nice and safe like.

when-using-the-right-click-join-team-opt.text: If the player has a cat following them:

steps.npc: No cats.
Yep, they might get into the brew, and I know a few pirates that are allergic to them.

when-using-the-right-click-join-team-opt.text: If the player has a different follower out:

steps.text: You cannot take your follower into the game.

when-using-the-right-click-join-team-opt.text: If the player is on a PvP world:

steps.npc: Hah!

steps.text: This minigame is unavailable on this world.

when-using-the-right-click-join-team-opt.text: If the player has less than 40 cooking:

steps.npc: You a good cook?
Then you don't get in. Cooking 40 or over, Cooking Guild regulations, if you catch my drift.

when-using-the-right-click-join-team-opt.text: If none of the previous conditions apply:

steps.text: The player is teleported into one of the Trouble Brewing waiting rooms.

contacting-through-astral-contact.player: It's [player name]. I'm using my magic to communicate to you. Don't worry.

contacting-through-astral-contact.text: If the player has less than 40 cooking:

steps.npc: Well, I'm not sayin' anything to anyone unless they have decent cookin' skills.

contacting-through-astral-contact.text: If the player is near the Trouble Brewing distillery:

steps.npc: I figured, seeing as I can see you over there! I don't make deals like this.

contacting-through-astral-contact.text: If the player is somewhere else:

steps.npc: The sooner you get out of my head the better. So, you here for the... information?
Look [miss/pal], you interrupted me for a reason, you must be after something.

options.text: How much time till the next game of Trouble Brewing starts?

steps.player: How much time till the next game of Trouble Brewing starts?

steps.npc: Ah, that's information I can help yer with.

steps.text: If there are too few people to start a game:

steps.npc: A game is ready to start just as soon as there are enough people.

steps.player: And how many people are there?

steps.npc: There are [X] people on Dan's team, and [X] on San's. There needs to be one on each in order for a game to start!
Anything else?

steps.text: If a game is being played:

steps.npc: There's a game on at the moment, and another will be starting in [X] minutes time!
Anything else?

steps.text: If a game has recently ended:

steps.npc: A game has just ended, and another will be starting in [X] minutes time!
Anything else?

options.text: How many people are waiting for a game to start?

steps.player: How many people are waiting for a game to start?

steps.text: If there are no players in the lobby:

steps.npc: No-one's waiting at the moment. Perhaps you can get some people interested.

steps.text: If there are players in the lobby:

steps.npc: There [is/are]] [no one/one person/X people] on Dan's team...
... and there [is/are]] [no one/one person/X people] on San's team. Anything else?

options.text: I have no idea what you're talking about.

steps.player: I have no idea what you are talking about.

steps.npc: Then sling yer 'ook!

overhead-dialogue.text: If there are too few people to start a game:

steps.npc: All ready to go, anyone want to join in?

overhead-dialogue.text: If a game is about to start:

steps.npc: Get a move on, these two aim to start in [1-3] minute(s)
